verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents its own bank connectivity: it merges the business account with bookkeeping, supports over 4,000 banks and neobanks, and lets users map invoices to bank payments. Partner integrations that 'transfer data automatically' are mentioned only generically, and nothing names payment processors or payroll systems feeding the ledger. Missing for 10: documented payment-processor integrations, documented payroll integration, detail on automatic ledger posting from these sources, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Seamlessly merge your business account and bookkeeping and pay your invoices directly from sevdesk. We already support over 4,000 banks and neobanks.
Map invoices directly to your bank payments.
Expand your features with a wide range of partner integrations. Use interfaces to work more efficiently and transfer data automatically.
